Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
Atomically transition orders to ready state to prevent duplicate notifications (#42)

* fix: send document-ready email on N8N inline-response path

The "document ready" email was only wired into the async N8N callback
(POST /api/orders/:orderId/document). When N8N's HTTP response to the
initial webhook contained the documentUrl inline (the production path),
the order was marked ready but no email or success-webhook ever fired.

Extract the post-ready side effects (Clerk email fallback, send email,
fire N8N_DOC_SUCCESS_WEBHOOK) into shared notifyDocumentReady() and
invoke from both delivery paths with the same idempotency guard
(previous documentStatus !== 'ready').

Adds Vitest coverage for the inline path: email fires on first ready,
skipped on re-delivery.

* fix: atomic markOrderReady transition + resume-generation inline path

Address review findings on commit c652b57:

HIGH — Eliminate duplicate-email race between the inline N8N response
path (server/routes/orders.ts) and the async callback path
(server/routes/n8n.ts). When both fire near-simultaneously for the same
order, the previous read-then-write idempotency guard could let the
second writer's stale order snapshot pass the check, causing two emails
plus two success webhooks.

Fix: add storage.markOrderReady(orderId, documentUrl) which performs an
atomic UPDATE ... WHERE documentStatus IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready'
RETURNING *. Only the first writer to flip the status gets a row back;
the loser silently no-ops. Both callers (inline and async) now gate
notifyDocumentReady on the returned row.

MEDIUM — Wire the same inline-response handler into the
resume-generation route. Previously a resumed generation that returned
the document URL inline would not trigger the email or success webhook.

Tests:
- n8n-callback.test.ts: assertions updated to mock markOrderReady; new
  test for the lost-race case (markOrderReady → undefined ⇒ no notify).
- document-generation.test.ts: inline-path test asserts markOrderReady;
  idempotency test now exercises the atomic-undefined path.

15/15 n8n-callback + 17/17 document-generation pass; typecheck clean.
The 6 checkout-flow failures are pre-existing and unrelated.

* ci(e2e): add SESSION_SECRET and N8N_DOC_SUCCESS_WEBHOOK to env

server/env.ts has required these two vars at startup since the email
feature merged (commit 3820756), but the Playwright E2E workflow's env
block was never updated. The dev server therefore exits before
Playwright's webServer probe succeeds, and every E2E spec fails.

Both values are placeholders consumed only by env validation —
SESSION_SECRET is unused in tests (BYPASS_AUTH is true), and
N8N_DOC_SUCCESS_WEBHOOK points to an unbound localhost port to match
the existing N8N_WEBHOOK_URL pattern.

* ci(e2e): replace ${{ secrets.X_TEST }} refs with literal placeholders

The previous workflow referred to repository-scoped secrets (CLERK_*_TEST,
STRIPE_*_TEST, RESEND_API_KEY_TEST). When those secrets aren't configured
at the repo level, GitHub interpolates ${{ secrets.X }} as an empty
string, which server/env.ts rejects, causing the dev server to exit
before Playwright's webServer probe — same symptom as the missing
SESSION_SECRET / N8N_DOC_SUCCESS_WEBHOOK case.

Use the same literal test placeholders as server/__tests__/setup.ts.
BYPASS_AUTH=true is set on the job so Clerk auth is short-circuited,
and N8N / external HTTP calls go to mocked localhost URLs already.
These values exist only to satisfy env validation.

Message:
feat: Phase 0-1 — Security hardening, test infrastructure, Replit removal (#18)

* feat: remove Replit dependencies, fix security vulnerabilities, add test infrastructure

Phase 0-1 batch covering 8 QAL cards:

- QAL-56: Remove all Replit dependencies (replitAuth.ts deleted, stripe-replit-sync removed,
  3 Vite plugins removed, .replit gitignored, env vars replaced with APP_URL)
- QAL-60: Environment variable validation with startup guards (process.exit on missing required vars)
- QAL-62: Fix 6 security vulnerabilities (auth guards on analytics/orders/templates,
  path traversal protection, N8N webhook secret enforcement, SESSION_SECRET validation)
- QAL-75: Fix Faraid calculator bug — sisters silently dropped when brothers present
- QAL-58: GitHub Actions CI pipeline (Vitest + Playwright workflows)
- QAL-71: Vitest + Supertest + Playwright test infrastructure
- QAL-72: 14 Faraid calculator unit tests with 100% coverage target
- QAL-73: SESSION_SECRET regression guard (16 tests)
- QAL-64: formData canonical Zod schema for all 14 onboarding steps
- QAL-65: Enum value lists for CHECK constraints

Note: isAuthenticated is a passthrough stub pending QAL-54 (Clerk integration).
Auth guards are structurally correct and will be functional once Clerk is wired.
